description: Details required by Condition 4 (Flood Risk Assessment/Sustainable Drainage Systems Strategy) of planning permission PP/26/02080 (Internal reconfigurations at lower ground floor including rear infill extension; new internal stair and lift; reconfigured secondary front entrance below entrance staircase. Reconfigurations at ground floor level; Re-orientated external entrance staircase level including new internal stair and lift; internal  rear infill extension. Internal reconfigurations at first floor level, including new internal stair and lift; 2no. timber frame French doors to rear with Juliet balconies; 1no. roof light down to ground floor living area. Internal reconfigurations at second floor, including new internal stair and lift; 1no. new timber frame French doors to roof terrace. Extension of front and rear mansards with white-painted timber sash windows. Replacement of slate roof covering and replaced flat roof to match existing. Installation of 3no. roof lights on new main roof)
